text.en:
Repealing
Clause. All Executive orders, rules, regulations
other issuances or parts thereof which are inconsistent
with the provisions of
this Executive order are hereby revoked or modified accordingly.

Effectivity.
This Executive order shall take effect immediately
upon approval.
DONE in the City of Manila,
in the year of our
Lord, two thousand.

RONALD 0 B. ZAMORA
